caption: The drawing depicts a figure resembling a doll or puppet with a light brown face and hands, wearing a wide-brimmed gray hat with a round crown. The figure has white hair partially covered by a white lace cap. Its clothing includes a long, floral-patterned overcoat predominantly cream in color with pink and red roses and green leaves, lined and accented with green trim, over a pale green blouse with ruffled cuffs. The figure wears a voluminous dark blue skirt that reaches the floor and has horizontal orange and gray stripes near the hem. Over the shoulders, there is a red shawl with a blue lining, draping down the back. The figure holds a dark blue cane in its left hand. Shoes are pointed with a pattern, appearing in shades of pink and green. The background is plain off-white, and the artist’s name, Rose Campbell Geike, is inscribed in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Mother Goose marionette
